notes.summary: Requires a ctutils with RUSTSEC-2026-0385 fixed, for the constant-time comparison behind netcode's packet authentication.
fixed: ctutils before 0.4.4 could generate branches on secret values in its constant-time masks and comparisons (RUSTSEC-2026-0385). netcode's Poly1305 tag verification goes through it, so dream-net now requires ctutils 0.4.4 or newer, which also moves projects whose lockfiles still held an older version.
